description_en: Creates a new application based on an official or private template in Cloud Architect Design Tools (CADT). Before you call this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing methods and pricing of Alibaba Cloud services
description_zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解阿里云产品的收费方式和价格。基于CADT上官方模板或私有模板创建新的应用
name: CreateApplication

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the value from your client and make sure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the application.

The application name must be unique and cannot be the same as the name of another application. You can call the <props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428266.html</props><props="intl">ListApplication (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/bp-studio/latest/api-bpstudio-2021-09-31-listapplication)</props> operation to query the application list.
The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
输入应用名称。

应用名称需唯一，不能与其他应用名称重复，可以调用<props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428266.html</props><props="intl">ListApplication (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/bp-studio/latest/api-bpstudio-2021-09-31-listapplication)</props>获取应用列表。
长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、下划线（_）、或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The region ID. The region ID must be the same as the region where the template is published. Otherwise, the template falls back to the default version
parameters.help_zh: 区域ID需与模板已发布的 region 保持一致，否则会回退到 default 版本
parameters.name: area_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the application belongs.

<notice>This parameter affects the resource groups of all resources in the created application. Make sure that the resource groups of the imported resources are the same as this resource group.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用所属资源组ID

<notice>此参数将影响所创应用中所有资源的资源组，请确保导入资源的资源组与之一致></notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create the application asynchronously.

Asynchronous creation: The application ID is immediately returned, but the application is not yet created. The application status is Creating. You must wait until the application is created and the status changes to Modified before you can perform subsequent operations.

Synchronous creation: The application ID is returned after the application is created.

Note: If the application template is large and contains many template variables, synchronous creation may time out. In this case, use asynchronous creation
parameters.help_zh:
是否异步创建应用

异步创建：立即返回应用ID，但是应用此时没有创建完成，应用状态为 Creating ，需要等待应用创建完成，状态变为 Modified 才可以进行后续的处理。

非异步创建：应用创建完成后返回应用ID

注：当应用模版很大，模版变量很多时，使用非异步创建可能会发生超时情况，此时需要采用异步创建
parameters.name: create_async

parameters.help_en: The list of instances to be replaced. Creation in an existing VPC is supported
parameters.name: instances

parameters.help_en: The configuration parameters of the application. For example, enableMonitor specifies whether automatic creation of CloudMonitor is enabled. enableReport specifies whether to generate relevant reports. Setting enableCompliance to 1 enables compliance checks
parameters.help_zh: 应用相关配置参数，例如：enableMonitor 代表是否自动创建云监控; enableReport 代表是否生成相关报告,enableCompliance设置为1代表开启合规检查
parameters.name: configuration

parameters.help_en: The variables for the template. For templates with parameters, this field is used to pass the relevant parameter values. If this field is not passed, the default values are used
parameters.help_zh: 对于带参数的模板，这个字段用于传递相关参数值，如果未传递，则使用默认值
parameters.name: variables

parameters.help_en: The list of variable values for the process
parameters.name: process_variables
